newsitem.title: USA: Alrenco Q4 to be below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Alrenco Q4 to be below expectations.

text.p: Alrenco Inc said Friday its net earnings for the fourth quarter are expected to be below expectations.
It said fourth quarter earnings per share are expected to be flat with or slightly below year-ago earnings of $0.16 a share.

Alrenco, which operates rental-purchase stores in the Southeast, Mid-Atlantic and Midwest, added that revenues for the fourth quarter are expected to be on line with current estimates. Year-ago quarterly revenues were $11.3 million.

The company did not specify projections for the fourth quarter, and a spokesman was not immediately available. According to First Call, the mean earnings estimate for the fourth quarter is $0.26 a share with a range of $0.25 to $0.26.

Alrenco said the company is increasing its advertising expenditures in the fourth quarter by about 20 percent to take advantage of strong rental-purchase activity during the holiday season. It also plans to write off distressed merchandise, and will be overstaffing and increasing supervision at certain acquired stores.
As a result, fourth quarter store salaries and other expenses will be increased by up to 10 percent.

"We have acquired 71 stores in 1996 and a majority of them are performing on target with, or better than, our expectations," Alrenco Chairman Michael Walts said in a statement. "However, there are a number of acquired stores that have accumulated returned rental merchandise that is unsuitable for further rental. In addition, we have seen slower growth in terms of units on rent in several markets."
Actual results for the fourth quarter and full year are expected to be released in February, after completion of the year-end audit.

"Our outlook for 1997 has not changed," Walts added. "We are extremely pleased with the operations at most of our existing stores, and we will continue to aggressively pursue attractive acquisition opportunities to add to our portfolio of rental purchase stores."
Alrenco operates 124 rental-purchase stores in 17 states.
